spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Killed, slain.
E.
नि affir. हत killing.

n. (-नं)
Killing, slaughter.
E.
नि before हनन killed.

mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ)
Murderous, who or what kills.
E.
नि before हन to kill, तृच् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Killed.
E.
नि, हन to kill, pass. v., शानच् aff.

m. (-वः)
Calling, calling to.
E.
नि before ह्वे to call, अप् aff.

f. (-का)
An iguana or the Gangetic alligator.
E.
नि before हा to quit, Uṇādi aff. कन्.

m. (-रः)
Frost, dew: see नीहार.

m. (-रः)
1 Frost, hoar frost.
2 Heavy dew.
E.
नि before हृ to steal or take, aff. घञ्.

n. (-नं)
Killing, slaughter.
E.
नि before हिंस to kill or hurt, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Deposited, delivered, given, entrusted.
2 Applied to, bestowed upon.
3 Laid, (as dust by rain.)
E.
नि before धा to have, aff. क्त.

m. (-नः)
A low man, an outcast.
E.
नि before हीन abandoned.

m. (-वः)
1 Denial or concealment of knowledge, dissimulation, secrecy.
2 Concealment in general.
3 Mistrust, doubt, suspicion.
4

Wickedness.
5

A secret.
E.
नि before ह्नु to hide or secrete, aff. अच्.

m. (-दी)
A defendant or witness who prevaricates or tries to hide the truth.
E.
निह्नव, and वादिन who speaks.

n. (-रं)
An evasive reply or defence.
E.
निह्नव, and उत्तर answer.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Concealed, secreted.
2 Denied, evaded.
E.
नि before ह्नु to secrete, aff. क्त.

f. (-तिः)
1 Denial or concealment of knowledge, dissimulation, reserve, secrecy.
2 Hiding, concealment.
E.
नि before ह्नु to secrete, aff. क्तिन्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Insinuating, using double entendre.
E.
नि, ह्नु to secrete, शानच् aff.

m. (-दः)
Sound.
E.
नि before ह्रद to sound, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Sounding, making a noise.
E.
निह्राद, and मतुप् aff.
